capabilities: Answer questions by searching notes by keyword and meaning
Create and file notes from the user's own templates, folders and properties
Dictate by voice and have answers read aloud
Chat with the same assistant from Telegram and a companion phone app
Run routines such as daily digests and turn phrases into Kanban boards
extras: Freemium: the author's own provider (Elton AI) has a free trial via promo code Gift and funds development, but any other provider works without it. The relay server for the phone app is closed-source, though it only carries end-to-end encrypted traffic and the plugin works fully without it. Keys are stored in plain text in data.json. The catalogue listing carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions of your vault in plain language or to capture, dictate and file notes remotely when you are away from the app.
